requirement: Recover only vault/escrow, leave native world/player progress untouched, and guarantee conservation under independent rollback/crash.
conclusion: A vault-only snapshot restore is insufficient. Strict recovery needs authoritative durable evidence of delivery and subsequent native effects, or restrictions/reconciliation outside vault custody.
important_boundary: The model demonstrates the inconsistent snapshot combinations; it is not a proof against every possible redesigned game engine or a claim that a journal can never help.

source_findings.finding: GiveItem transfers custody to native inventory and removes the escrow row.
Native transfer changes live records/items; transaction state is returned by OnSave. Receipt is not a cross-shard atomic disk commit.
Current implementation restores world and player images, so it does not meet the newly requested isolation boundary.
